user.title: EuroJackpot Analyzer
user.description: Adds the last draw, the next draw and jackpot, number statistics and a ticket generator. Data comes from Allwyn and the official EuroJackpot service. No account needed.

abort.already_configured: EuroJackpot Analyzer is already set up.

init.title: EuroJackpot Analyzer options

data.github_token: GitHub token to read your synced tickets (optional)

init.description: Alerts for new draws, a high jackpot and the results of your tickets. The token (permission: gist) is the same one you use in the app for the ticket sync.

generate_ticket.name: Generate ticket
generate_ticket.description: Generates a ticket of 1 to 12 columns (5 numbers + 2 Euro numbers each) using the number statistics, and returns the columns and the total cost.

algorithm.name: Algorithm
algorithm.description: How the numbers are chosen. The automatic options pick a random algorithm per ticket or per column.

period.name: Period
period.description: The part of the history the statistics are based on.

save.name: Save as ticket
save.description: Add the ticket to My tickets for the next draw (and to your sync gist when a token is set).

analyze_ticket.name: Analyze ticket
analyze_ticket.description: Exact win probabilities, expected prize and a history check for a ticket. It is statistics, not a prediction: every column has the same chance.

numbers.name: Numbers
numbers.description: Columns like '5 12 23 34 45 + 3 7', separated by ';'. Leave empty to use a synced ticket (uid) or the last generated ticket.

uid.name: Ticket uid
uid.description: The uid of a synced ticket (see the My tickets sensor).

country.name: Country
country.description: Country code for the prize classes (GR adds the Greek 1+1 class).

sync_tickets.name: Sync tickets
sync_tickets.description: Merges the tickets with your private sync gist on GitHub now (needs the token in the options).

options.auto_ticket: Automatic - one random algorithm per ticket
